nodes.label: Next.js starter README
nodes.rationale: Describes the frontend as a create-next-app project, its npm run dev startup path, localhost:3000 default, app/page.tsx entry point, next/font, and Vercel deployment link.

edges.context: The README identifies a Next.js create-next-app frontend and the public asset is explicitly named next.svg.
The README links deployment to Vercel and the public asset is named vercel.svg.
